front: What are the ISA sea-level reference values?
back:
Temperature **15°C**
Pressure **1,013.25 hPa**
Density **1.225 kg/m³**
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>ISA at sea level</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>15°C</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>1,013.25 hPa</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>1.225 kg/m³</text></svg>

front: State Boyle’s law.
back:
At constant temperature: **P₁V₁ = P₂V₂**.
Pressure and volume vary inversely.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Boyle</text><rect x='28' y='65' width='95' height='66' rx='7' fill='#2784b5'/><rect x='197' y='65' width='95' height='66' rx='7' fill='#d87926'/><text x='75' y='96' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>P × V</text><text x='245' y='96' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>constant T</text><path d='M130 98 L190 98' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='3' marker-end='url(#a)'/><text x='160' y='155' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>inverse</text><defs><marker id='a' markerWidth='8' markerHeight='8' refX='5' refY='3' orient='auto'><path d='M0 0 L6 3 L0 6' fill='none' stroke='#203040'/></marker></defs></svg>

front: A 1 L trapped gas volume reaches half its original pressure at constant temperature. New volume?
back: **2 L** (Boyle: pressure halves, volume doubles).

front: State Charles’ law and the temperature unit required.
back:
At constant pressure: **V₁/T₁ = V₂/T₂**.
Use absolute temperature in **kelvin**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Charles</text><rect x='28' y='65' width='95' height='66' rx='7' fill='#2784b5'/><rect x='197' y='65' width='95' height='66' rx='7' fill='#d87926'/><text x='75' y='96' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>V / T</text><text x='245' y='96' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>constant P</text><path d='M130 98 L190 98' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='3' marker-end='url(#a)'/><text x='160' y='155' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>T in kelvin</text><defs><marker id='a' markerWidth='8' markerHeight='8' refX='5' refY='3' orient='auto'><path d='M0 0 L6 3 L0 6' fill='none' stroke='#203040'/></marker></defs></svg>

front: A 3.0 L gas at 300 K warms to 330 K at constant pressure. New volume?
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Charles example</text><rect x='28' y='65' width='95' height='66' rx='7' fill='#2784b5'/><rect x='197' y='65' width='95' height='66' rx='7' fill='#d87926'/><text x='75' y='96' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>300 K → 330 K</text><text x='245' y='96' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>3.0 L → 3.3 L</text><path d='M130 98 L190 98' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='3' marker-end='url(#a)'/><text x='160' y='155' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>constant P</text><defs><marker id='a' markerWidth='8' markerHeight='8' refX='5' refY='3' orient='auto'><path d='M0 0 L6 3 L0 6' fill='none' stroke='#203040'/></marker></defs></svg>

front: When do you use the combined gas law?
back:
When **pressure, volume and temperature** all change.
**P₁V₁/T₁ = P₂V₂/T₂**; temperatures in kelvin.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Combined law</text><rect x='28' y='65' width='95' height='66' rx='7' fill='#2784b5'/><rect x='197' y='65' width='95' height='66' rx='7' fill='#d87926'/><text x='75' y='96' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>P₁V₁/T₁</text><text x='245' y='96' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>P₂V₂/T₂</text><path d='M130 98 L190 98' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='3' marker-end='url(#a)'/><text x='160' y='155' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>kelvin</text><defs><marker id='a' markerWidth='8' markerHeight='8' refX='5' refY='3' orient='auto'><path d='M0 0 L6 3 L0 6' fill='none' stroke='#203040'/></marker></defs></svg>

front: State Dalton’s law.
back:
Total pressure is the **sum of partial pressures**.
pO₂ ≈ **0.21 × Ptotal**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Dalton</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>total pressure</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>sum of partials</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>pO₂ = 0.21 P</text></svg>

front: At 1,013 hPa, approximately what is oxygen partial pressure?
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Dalton example</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>1,013 hPa</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>× 0.21</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>≈213 hPa</text></svg>

front: At half MSL pressure (~507 hPa), what is oxygen partial pressure?
back:
0.21 × 507 ≈ **106 hPa**.
O₂ fraction remains 21%.

front: What does Henry’s law explain in aviation physiology?
back:
Dissolved gas amount tracks partial pressure.
Falling pressure can release nitrogen bubbles → DCS.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Henry</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>pressure falls</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>N₂ leaves solution</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>bubbles / DCS</text></svg>

front: What happens to trapped gas on climb as ambient pressure falls?
back: It expands (Boyle’s law); ears, sinuses, gut, teeth and gas spaces may be affected.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Climb</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>outside pressure ↓</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>trapped gas expands</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>pain / discomfort</text></svg>

front: Define hypoxia.
back: Insufficient oxygen is available to body tissues.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Air → blood → tissue</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>O₂ partial pressure ↓</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>blood delivery ↓</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>tissue hypoxia</text></svg>

front: Why does altitude cause hypoxia if oxygen remains 21%?
back: Total pressure and **oxygen partial pressure** fall, reducing oxygen transfer into blood.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Altitude</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>21% O₂ fraction</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>total pressure ↓</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>pO₂ ↓</text></svg>

front: What is hypoxic (hypobaric) hypoxia?
back: Low oxygen partial pressure, typically at altitude.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Hypoxic</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>altitude</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>low pO₂</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>less transfer</text></svg>

front: What causes anaemic hypoxia?
back: Blood cannot carry enough oxygen; **CO poisoning** is a tested cause.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Anaemic</text><circle cx='75' cy='105' r='31' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='75' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>O₂</text><text x='75' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>CO binds Hb</text><circle cx='160' cy='105' r='31' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='160' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>Defence</text><text x='160' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>O₂ carriage ↓</text><circle cx='245' cy='105' r='31' fill='#d87926'/><text x='245' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>Clot</text><text x='245' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>tissue supply ↓</text></svg>

front: What is stagnant (circulatory) hypoxia?
back: Inadequate blood flow / oxygen delivery to tissues; high positive G can contribute.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Stagnant</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>blood flow ↓</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>delivery ↓</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>brain at risk</text></svg>

front: What is histotoxic hypoxia?
back: Cells cannot use delivered oxygen normally; some poisons / alcohol can impair use.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Histotoxic</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>O₂ delivered</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>cell use impaired</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>tissue deficit</text></svg>

front: Name a visible hypoxia clue tested in the bank.
back: Blue lips or fingernails: **cyanosis**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Hypoxia clue</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>blue lips</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>blue nail beds</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>cyanosis</text></svg>

front: Which sense is most affected by hypoxia?
back: **Vision**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Hypoxia</text><ellipse cx='160' cy='108' rx='104' ry='52' fill='white' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='160' cy='108' r='29' fill='#69a9d1' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='160' cy='108' r='12' fill='#203040'/><text x='160' y='178' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#203040'>vision</text></svg>

front: What is the first response if hypoxia is suspected in flight?
back: Keep control; use oxygen if available / appropriate, descend, land and seek help as needed.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Suspect hypoxia</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>control aircraft</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>oxygen + descend</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>land / assistance</text></svg>

front: What is the principal hypoxia symptom trap when it is insidious?
back: Judgement and self-awareness may fail before the pilot recognizes impairment.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Insidious hypoxia</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>judgement ↓</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>awareness ↓</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>pilot may not notice</text></svg>

front: What aircraft defect can cause CO poisoning?
back: A **crack in the cabin-heater heat exchanger** can admit CO.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Heater exhaust</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>cracked exchanger</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>CO enters cabin</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>poisoning risk</text></svg>

front: Name another tested source of carbon monoxide exposure.
back: **Smoking**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>CO source</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>smoking</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>CO exposure</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>O₂ transport impaired</text></svg>

front: How does carbon monoxide cause anaemic hypoxia?
back: CO binds haemoglobin, reducing the blood’s oxygen-carrying capacity.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>CO + haemoglobin</text><circle cx='75' cy='105' r='31' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='75' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>O₂</text><text x='75' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>CO binds strongly</text><circle cx='160' cy='105' r='31' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='160' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>Defence</text><text x='160' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>O₂ carriage ↓</text><circle cx='245' cy='105' r='31' fill='#d87926'/><text x='245' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>Clot</text><text x='245' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>anaemic hypoxia</text></svg>

front: What should a pilot do if CO is suspected?
back: Heater off; fresh air / oxygen as appropriate; land promptly and obtain medical attention.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Suspected CO</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>heater off</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>fresh air / oxygen</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>land + medical care</text></svg>

front: What is the primary function of red blood cells (erythrocytes)?
back: Transport **oxygen** via haemoglobin.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Blood roles</text><circle cx='75' cy='105' r='31' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='75' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>O₂</text><text x='75' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>erythrocytes</text><circle cx='160' cy='105' r='31' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='160' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>Defence</text><text x='160' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>leucocytes</text><circle cx='245' cy='105' r='31' fill='#d87926'/><text x='245' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>Clot</text><text x='245' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>thrombocytes</text></svg>

front: What is the primary function of white blood cells (leucocytes)?
back: **Immune defence**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Blood roles</text><circle cx='75' cy='105' r='31' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='75' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>O₂</text><text x='75' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>erythrocytes</text><circle cx='160' cy='105' r='31' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='160' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>Defence</text><text x='160' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>leucocytes</text><circle cx='245' cy='105' r='31' fill='#d87926'/><text x='245' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>Clot</text><text x='245' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>thrombocytes</text></svg>

front: What is the primary function of platelets (thrombocytes)?
back: Blood **clotting / coagulation**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Blood roles</text><circle cx='75' cy='105' r='31' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='75' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>O₂</text><text x='75' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>erythrocytes</text><circle cx='160' cy='105' r='31' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='160' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>Defence</text><text x='160' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>leucocytes</text><circle cx='245' cy='105' r='31' fill='#d87926'/><text x='245' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>Clot</text><text x='245' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>thrombocytes</text></svg>

front: Which is NOT the bank’s hypoxia risk factor: smoking, menstruation, blood donation or diving?
back: **Diving**. It is a decompression-sickness risk, not the bank’s hypoxia answer.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Keep separate</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>diving → DCS</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>not hypoxia answer</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>avoid confusion</text></svg>

front: What causes hyperventilation symptoms?
back: Overbreathing removes too much CO₂; blood chemistry changes.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Overbreathing</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>CO₂ washed out</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>blood chemistry shifts</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>symptoms</text></svg>

front: Which symptom is NOT expected in hyperventilation in the bank?
back: **Cyanosis**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Hyperventilation</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>tingling / spasm</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>dizziness</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>not cyanosis</text></svg>

front: Why can diving before flight cause decompression sickness?
back: Extra nitrogen dissolves in tissues underwater; lower pressure can form bubbles.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Dive → flight</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>N₂ dissolves</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>pressure falls</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>bubbles / DCS</text></svg>

front: What do “bends,” “creeps” and “chokes” describe?
back:
Bends = joint/limb pain
Creeps = itchy skin
Chokes = breathing problems
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>DCS signs</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>Bends: joints</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>Creeps: skin</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>Chokes: breathing</text></svg>

front: What is the response to suspected DCS?
back: Oxygen, descend if safe, land and seek urgent medical help; do not rub painful joints.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>DCS response</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>oxygen</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>descend / land</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>urgent medical help</text></svg>

front: What connects the middle ear to the nose/throat?
back: The **Eustachian tube**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Middle ear</text><path d='M104 145 C82 95 100 48 148 47 C192 46 208 83 192 111 C182 128 165 130 163 151' fill='none' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/><circle cx='162' cy='151' r='12' fill='#d87926'/><path d='M174 151 L239 151' stroke='#27845b' stroke-width='5'/><text x='160' y='184' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>Eustachian tube</text></svg>

front: When is pressure compensation between middle ear and environment impossible?
back: When the **Eustachian tube is blocked**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Pressure equalisation</text><path d='M104 145 C82 95 100 48 148 47 C192 46 208 83 192 111 C182 128 165 130 163 151' fill='none' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/><circle cx='162' cy='151' r='12' fill='#d87926'/><path d='M174 151 L239 151' stroke='#27845b' stroke-width='5'/><text x='160' y='184' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>tube open: equalises</text></svg>

front: What may help equalise middle-ear pressure gently?
back: Swallowing, yawning or gentle equalisation; never force through severe pain.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Gentle equalisation</text><path d='M104 145 C82 95 100 48 148 47 C192 46 208 83 192 111 C182 128 165 130 163 151' fill='none' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/><circle cx='162' cy='151' r='12' fill='#d87926'/><path d='M174 151 L239 151' stroke='#27845b' stroke-width='5'/><text x='160' y='184' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>swallow</text></svg>

front: What causes grey-out?
back: **Positive G** shifts blood away from the head; peripheral / colour vision fades.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Positive G</text><line x1='45' y1='137' x2='277' y2='137' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M145 137 L160 80 L175 137 Z' fill='#d87926'/><line x1='82' y1='136' x2='82' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><line x1='235' y1='136' x2='235' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='82' cy='75' r='17' fill='#27845b'/><circle cx='235' cy='75' r='17' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='160' y='178' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>blood shifts down</text></svg>

front: What is blackout in relation to G?
back: More severe / sustained positive G can cause loss of vision, possibly unconsciousness.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Positive G</text><line x1='45' y1='137' x2='277' y2='137' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M145 137 L160 80 L175 137 Z' fill='#d87926'/><line x1='82' y1='136' x2='82' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><line x1='235' y1='136' x2='235' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='82' cy='75' r='17' fill='#27845b'/><circle cx='235' cy='75' r='17' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='160' y='178' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>grey-out</text></svg>

front: What does red-out mean?
back: “Red vision” during **negative G-loads**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Negative G</text><line x1='45' y1='137' x2='277' y2='137' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M145 137 L160 80 L175 137 Z' fill='#d87926'/><line x1='82' y1='136' x2='82' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><line x1='235' y1='136' x2='235' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='82' cy='75' r='17' fill='#27845b'/><circle cx='235' cy='75' r='17' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='160' y='178' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>blood toward head</text></svg>

front: What is the lesson’s sustained-G tolerance example for an unprotected person?
back: About **+3.5 G / −3 G** for more than 1 second; not an operating limit.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Lesson example</text><line x1='45' y1='137' x2='277' y2='137' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M145 137 L160 80 L175 137 Z' fill='#d87926'/><line x1='82' y1='136' x2='82' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><line x1='235' y1='136' x2='235' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='82' cy='75' r='17' fill='#27845b'/><circle cx='235' cy='75' r='17' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='160' y='178' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>+3.5 G</text></svg>

front: What anti-G tolerance example does the lesson cite?
back: About **+7 to +8 G** with anti-G protection; not a light-aircraft operating limit.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Protection example</text><line x1='45' y1='137' x2='277' y2='137' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M145 137 L160 80 L175 137 Z' fill='#d87926'/><line x1='82' y1='136' x2='82' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><line x1='235' y1='136' x2='235' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='82' cy='75' r='17' fill='#27845b'/><circle cx='235' cy='75' r='17' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='160' y='178' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>anti-G suit</text></svg>

front: What brief impact tolerances are cited in the lesson?
back: **25 G vertical** and **45 G perpendicular to vertical**; not flight targets or limits.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Impact example</text><line x1='45' y1='137' x2='277' y2='137' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M145 137 L160 80 L175 137 Z' fill='#d87926'/><line x1='82' y1='136' x2='82' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><line x1='235' y1='136' x2='235' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='82' cy='75' r='17' fill='#27845b'/><circle cx='235' cy='75' r='17' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='160' y='178' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>25 G vertical</text></svg>

front: What is load factor n?
back: **n = Lift / Weight**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Load factor</text><line x1='45' y1='137' x2='277' y2='137' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M145 137 L160 80 L175 137 Z' fill='#d87926'/><line x1='82' y1='136' x2='82' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><line x1='235' y1='136' x2='235' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='82' cy='75' r='17' fill='#27845b'/><circle cx='235' cy='75' r='17' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='160' y='178' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>Lift</text></svg>

front: State the load-factor formula for a coordinated level turn.
back: **n = 1 / cos(bank angle)**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Level turn</text><line x1='45' y1='137' x2='277' y2='137' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M145 137 L160 80 L175 137 Z' fill='#d87926'/><line x1='82' y1='136' x2='82' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><line x1='235' y1='136' x2='235' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='82' cy='75' r='17' fill='#27845b'/><circle cx='235' cy='75' r='17' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='160' y='178' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>n = 1 / cos φ</text></svg>

front: At 60° bank in a coordinated level turn, what is load factor?
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>60° bank</text><line x1='45' y1='137' x2='277' y2='137' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M145 137 L160 80 L175 137 Z' fill='#d87926'/><line x1='82' y1='136' x2='82' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><line x1='235' y1='136' x2='235' y2='90' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='82' cy='75' r='17' fill='#27845b'/><circle cx='235' cy='75' r='17' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='160' y='178' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>cos 60° = 0.5</text></svg>

front: What does the autonomic nervous system regulate?
back: Involuntary functions such as **breathing, digestion and heart rate**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Autonomic system</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>breathing</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>digestion</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>heart rate</text></svg>

front: Define a reflex.
back: An involuntary, stereotyped response to stimulation of a receptor.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Receptor stimulated</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>involuntary response</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>stereotyped</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>reflex</text></svg>

front: Which eye cells provide colour vision?
back: **Cones** (also sharp central/day vision).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Retina</text><ellipse cx='160' cy='108' rx='104' ry='52' fill='white' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='160' cy='108' r='29' fill='#69a9d1' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='160' cy='108' r='12' fill='#203040'/><text x='160' y='178' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#203040'>cones: colour</text></svg>

front: What is the role of rods?
back: Dim-light / night and peripheral vision; poor colour and fine detail.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Retina</text><ellipse cx='160' cy='108' rx='104' ry='52' fill='white' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='160' cy='108' r='29' fill='#69a9d1' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='160' cy='108' r='12' fill='#203040'/><text x='160' y='178' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#203040'>cones: colour</text></svg>

front: What is the blind spot?
back: The optic nerve / vessels pass through that area; it has no visual receptors.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Retina</text><ellipse cx='160' cy='108' rx='104' ry='52' fill='white' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='160' cy='108' r='29' fill='#69a9d1' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='160' cy='108' r='12' fill='#203040'/><text x='160' y='178' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#203040'>fovea: detail</text></svg>

front: What does the iris do?
back: Controls pupil size and the amount of incoming light.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Light</text><ellipse cx='160' cy='108' rx='104' ry='52' fill='white' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='160' cy='108' r='29' fill='#69a9d1' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='160' cy='108' r='12' fill='#203040'/><text x='160' y='178' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#203040'>iris controls</text></svg>

front: Define parallax error.
back: Wrong instrument reading caused by viewing the scale at an angle.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Instrument scale</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>view off-axis</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>pointer shifts</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>parallax error</text></svg>

front: How should a pilot avoid parallax on an analogue instrument?
back: View the scale straight-on; align pointer / mark with scale.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Scale reading</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>face-on view</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>align pointer</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>correct reading</text></svg>

front: What type of sunglasses should pilots choose?
back: **Non-polarised**, with suitable UV protection.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Pilot sunglasses</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>non-polarised</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>UV protection</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>displays remain visible</text></svg>

front: Why avoid polarised sunglasses in the cockpit?
back: They may obscure LCDs / instrument displays or interfere with viewing displays.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Polarised lens</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>display visibility ↓</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>LCD issue</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>choose non-polarised</text></svg>

front: What mainly causes visual illusions?
back: The **brain misinterprets** visual information.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Visual cue</text><ellipse cx='160' cy='108' rx='104' ry='52' fill='white' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='160' cy='108' r='29' fill='#69a9d1' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='160' cy='108' r='12' fill='#203040'/><text x='160' y='178' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#203040'>brain interprets</text></svg>

front: What helps night vision?
back: Use rods: allow dark adaptation, avoid bright light and scan slightly off a faint target.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Night vision</text><ellipse cx='160' cy='108' rx='104' ry='52' fill='white' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='160' cy='108' r='29' fill='#69a9d1' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='160' cy='108' r='12' fill='#203040'/><text x='160' y='178' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#203040'>rods</text></svg>

front: What do semicircular canals detect?
back: Angular / rotational acceleration (turning).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Inner ear</text><path d='M104 145 C82 95 100 48 148 47 C192 46 208 83 192 111 C182 128 165 130 163 151' fill='none' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/><circle cx='162' cy='151' r='12' fill='#d87926'/><path d='M174 151 L239 151' stroke='#27845b' stroke-width='5'/><text x='160' y='184' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>semicircular canals</text></svg>

front: What do otolith organs detect?
back: Linear acceleration and gravity / tilt.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Inner ear</text><path d='M104 145 C82 95 100 48 148 47 C192 46 208 83 192 111 C182 128 165 130 163 151' fill='none' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/><circle cx='162' cy='151' r='12' fill='#d87926'/><path d='M174 151 L239 151' stroke='#27845b' stroke-width='5'/><text x='160' y='184' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>otolith organs</text></svg>

front: What is the “leans” illusion?
back: A slow roll goes unnoticed; correction then feels like a bank the opposite way.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Slow roll</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>below detection</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>correction</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>opposite bank felt</text></svg>

front: After a prolonged turn, what may wings-level flight feel like?
back: A turn in the **opposite direction** (leans). Trust instruments.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Prolonged turn</text><path d='M104 145 C82 95 100 48 148 47 C192 46 208 83 192 111 C182 128 165 130 163 151' fill='none' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/><circle cx='162' cy='151' r='12' fill='#d87926'/><path d='M174 151 L239 151' stroke='#27845b' stroke-width='5'/><text x='160' y='184' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>canals adapt</text></svg>

front: What pitch illusion can acceleration in straight, level flight create?
back: A **climb / nose-up** illusion (somatogravic).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Straight-level acceleration</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>body feels pitch-up</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>climb illusion</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>trust instruments</text></svg>

front: What pitch illusion can deceleration create?
back: A **descent / nose-down** illusion.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Deceleration</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>body feels pitch-down</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>descent illusion</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>trust instruments</text></svg>

front: When is Coriolis vertigo most likely?
back: When moving the head **during a turn**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Turn</text><path d='M104 145 C82 95 100 48 148 47 C192 46 208 83 192 111 C182 128 165 130 163 151' fill='none' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/><circle cx='162' cy='151' r='12' fill='#d87926'/><path d='M174 151 L239 151' stroke='#27845b' stroke-width='5'/><text x='160' y='184' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>head movement</text></svg>

front: How can a pilot reduce Coriolis illusion risk?
back: Keep the head still during turns; use instruments if disoriented.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>During turn</text><path d='M104 145 C82 95 100 48 148 47 C192 46 208 83 192 111 C182 128 165 130 163 151' fill='none' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/><circle cx='162' cy='151' r='12' fill='#d87926'/><path d='M174 151 L239 151' stroke='#27845b' stroke-width='5'/><text x='160' y='184' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#203040'>head still</text></svg>

front: Which flight condition does NOT usually stimulate motion sickness?
back: Non-accelerated, straight-and-level flight.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Motion triggers</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>turbulence / turns</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>alcohol / head movement</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>smooth level: less</text></svg>

front: Name motion-sickness triggers in flight.
back: Turbulence, alcohol, sensory mismatch and head movement in turns.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Sensory mismatch</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>turbulence</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>alcohol</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>head movement</text></svg>

front: What is autokinesis?
back: A fixed light in darkness appears to move; avoid staring at one light.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Darkness</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>fixed light</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>seems to move</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>autokinesis</text></svg>

front: What is the safe response to spatial disorientation?
back: Minimise head movement; stabilize and trust instruments over bodily sensation.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Disorientation</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>stop manoeuvring</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>trust instruments</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>stabilize</text></svg>

front: What does an upslope runway tend to make the approach look like?
back: It can appear **too high**; pilot may descend below the normal glide slope.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Upslope runway</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>appears high</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>pilot descends</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>below glide slope</text></svg>

front: What answer does bank Q21 mark for an upslope runway impression?
back: **Overshoot** (bank wording trap). Q54 separately marks perceived too high → descent below glide slope.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Upslope trap</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>Q21: overshoot</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>Q54: too high</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>bank answers differ</text></svg>
tip: Memorize both exact bank phrasings; fly the stabilized approach.

front: What is the tendency with a downslope runway?
back: It can appear too low, encouraging a higher approach.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Downslope</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>appears low</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>pilot flies high</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>glide path</text></svg>

front: What is the tendency with a narrow runway?
back: May seem too high / close, encouraging a low approach.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Narrow runway</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>seems high / close</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>low approach tendency</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>cross-check</text></svg>

front: What is the tendency with a wide runway?
back: May seem too low / far, encouraging a high approach and overshoot.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Wide runway</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>seems low / far</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>high approach</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>overshoot risk</text></svg>

front: What other visual cues can distort runway height or attitude?
back: Haze, snow, water, desert, false horizon, black-hole approach and target fixation.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Weak references</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>haze / snow / water</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>false horizon</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>black-hole / fixation</text></svg>

front: What condition is a tested risk factor for diabetes?
back: Being **overweight**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Risk factor</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>overweight</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>diabetes</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>fitness to fly</text></svg>

front: By how much does adult blood alcohol fall on average per hour in the bank?
back: Approximately **0.01% per hour**; not a safe-to-fly calculation.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Alcohol estimate</text><rect x='72' y='55' width='176' height='32' rx='8' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='76' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>0.01% per hour</text><rect x='72' y='100' width='176' height='32' rx='8' fill='#d87926'/><text x='160' y='121' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>varies by person</text><rect x='72' y='145' width='176' height='32' rx='8' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='160' y='166' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>not flight clearance</text></svg>

front: Estimate BAC after 3 hours from 0.08%, using 0.01%/h.
back: 0.08 − (3 × 0.01) = **0.05%**. Not an operational fitness decision.
