visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Worked estimate</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>0.08% start</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>−0.03%</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>0.05% after 3 h</text></svg>

front: What does I’M SAFE stand for?
back: Illness, Medication, Stress, Alcohol, Fatigue, Emotion.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>I’M SAFE</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>Illness / Medication</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>Stress / Alcohol</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>Fatigue / Emotion</text></svg>

front: What is the bank answer for an old bottle-to-throttle interval?
back: The bank does **not** establish one; lesson sources conflict (12 h vs 24 h). Follow current rules / advice; never fly impaired.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Old lesson conflict</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>12 h vs 24 h</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>not current clearance</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>do not fly impaired</text></svg>

front: What is the bank answer for short-term memory duration?
back: About **10–20 seconds**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Short-term memory</text><rect x='72' y='55' width='176' height='32' rx='8' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='76' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>10–20 seconds</text><rect x='72' y='100' width='176' height='32' rx='8' fill='#d87926'/><text x='160' y='121' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>brief holding</text><rect x='72' y='145' width='176' height='32' rx='8' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='160' y='166' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>rehearse / record</text></svg>

front: How many items does the primary bank say short-term memory holds?
back: **5 ± 2 items** for 10–20 seconds. This takes precedence over supplementary conflicting figures.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Bank answer</text><rect x='72' y='55' width='176' height='32' rx='8' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='76' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>5 ± 2 items</text><rect x='72' y='100' width='176' height='32' rx='8' fill='#d87926'/><text x='160' y='121' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>10–20 seconds</text><rect x='72' y='145' width='176' height='32' rx='8' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='160' y='166' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>use bank value</text></svg>

front: How can a pilot reduce working-memory load?
back: Use checklists, notes, readbacks, repetition and chunking.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Reduce memory load</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>checklist</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>write / read back</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>chunk + repeat</text></svg>

front: What is working memory?
back: The active holding and manipulation of information for a current task.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Memory types</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>short-term: hold</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>working: manipulate</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>long-term: store</text></svg>

front: What supports long-term memory encoding?
back: Repetition and meaningful / intense events.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Long-term memory</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>repetition</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>meaning</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>retention</text></svg>

front: What causes the majority of aviation accidents in the supplied bank?
back: **Human error**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Accident defence</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>human error</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>predictable</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>build barriers</text></svg>

front: What is confirmation bias?
back: Preferring evidence that supports your existing mental model.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Initial belief</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>seek support</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>discount conflict</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>confirmation bias</text></svg>

front: How can a pilot counter confirmation bias?
back: Seek disconfirming evidence; cross-check sources and reconsider with new information.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Hypothesis</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>seek contrary evidence</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>cross-check</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>update</text></svg>

front: What is expectation bias?
back: Seeing what you expect rather than what is actually there; it can cause human error.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Expectation</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>what I expect</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>≠ what is there</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>verify</text></svg>

front: What does the Swiss-cheese model explain?
back: An error / accident chain when holes in multiple defences line up.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Defence layers</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>holes align</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>chain passes through</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>accident</text></svg>

front: What is a latent error?
back: A hidden weakness remaining undetected in the system for a long time.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Latent</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>hidden condition</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>undetected</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>for a long time</text></svg>

front: How does an active error differ from a latent error?
back: Active error occurs at the point of action; latent error is a hidden system condition.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Error types</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>active: now</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>latent: hidden</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>system condition</text></svg>

front: Why can automation lead to complacency?
back: Increased cockpit automation can reduce vigilance; monitor and verify its outputs.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Automation</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>monitoring ↓</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>complacency risk</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>verify output</text></svg>

front: Define situational awareness.
back: Ongoing monitoring and understanding of the current flight situation.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>SA loop</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>perceive cues</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>understand meaning</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>anticipate next</text></svg>

front: What should a pilot do first when a problem occurs in flight?
back: **Fly the aircraft and keep it stable**, then address the problem while continuing to fly.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Problem</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>CONTROL first</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>assess / act</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>recheck</text></svg>

front: What is a simple in-flight problem-solving sequence?
back: Control → assess / prioritize → act (checklist as needed) → recheck.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Problem</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>CONTROL</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>ASSESS / ACT</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>RECHECK</text></svg>

front: How does standard radio phraseology help communication?
back: It provides a shared communication **code**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Sender</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>phraseology</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>shared code</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>receiver</text></svg>

front: What should a pilot do if a radio message is unclear?
back: Ask for clarification; do not fill in missing words from expectation.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Unclear message</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>pause</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>ask / read back</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>verify</text></svg>

front: What trait pairing does the bank mark as best?
back: **Extroverted–stable** (exam response, not an individual diagnosis).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Bank trait pair</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>extroverted</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>stable</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>exam wording</text></svg>

front: What is a macho attitude?
back: Taking risky manoeuvres to prove oneself or impress spectators.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Macho</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>prove / impress</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>unnecessary risk</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>avoid</text></svg>

front: Which dangerous attitudes commonly combine?
back: **Macho + invulnerability**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Attitude pairing</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>macho</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>+</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>invulnerability</text></svg>

front: What is invulnerability self-talk?
back: “It won’t happen to me.” Antidote: it can happen to me too; use margins.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Invulnerability</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>“not me”</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>can happen to me</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>use margins</text></svg>

front: What is the antidote to anti-authority?
back: Rules have reasons; follow them.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Anti-authority</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>“rules don’t apply”</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>rules have reasons</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>follow them</text></svg>

front: What is the antidote to impulsivity?
back: “Do it now” → **pause and think**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Impulsivity</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>act now</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>pause</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>think</text></svg>

front: What is the antidote to resignation / self-abandonment?
back: There is usually something useful to do; keep thinking and act / seek help.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Resignation</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>“nothing matters”</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>find useful action</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>seek help</text></svg>

front: What are the four appropriate ways to handle risk?
back: **Avoid, Reduce, Transfer, Accept**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>A-R-T-A</text><rect x='8' y='77' width='70' height='56' rx='8' fill='#27845b'/><text x='43' y='109' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='white'>Avoid</text><text x='84' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='86' y='77' width='70' height='56' rx='8' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='121' y='109' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='white'>Reduce / Transfer</text><text x='162' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='164' y='77' width='70' height='56' rx='8' fill='#d87926'/><text x='199' y='109' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='white'>Accept</text><text x='240' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text></svg>
tip: Accept means conscious residual risk—not ignore.

front: What does “risky shift” mean?
back: A tendency for people in groups to accept higher risks.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Group</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>discussion</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>risk acceptance ↑</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>risky shift</text></svg>

front: What increases the chance a pilot accepts higher risk in the bank?
back: **Group-dynamic effects**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Group dynamics</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>social influence</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>risk acceptance ↑</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>independent limits</text></svg>

front: Does transfer remove the pilot’s accountability?
back: No. It shares / passes exposure where appropriate, but does not remove pilot accountability.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Transfer risk</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>share exposure</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>accountability</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>still remains</text></svg>

front: What is the ideal arousal point on the bank diagram?
back: **Point B**: moderate arousal / stress.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Performance</text><path d='M35 165 C85 145 95 55 160 55 C225 55 235 145 285 165' fill='none' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='5'/><line x1='35' y1='170' x2='290' y2='170' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='40' y1='170' x2='40' y2='45' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='160' cy='65' r='6' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='190' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>B = ideal</text><circle cx='250' cy='132' r='6' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='250' y='190' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>moderate arousal</text></svg>

front: Which point represents an overstrained pilot in the bank diagram?
back: **Point D**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Performance</text><path d='M35 165 C85 145 95 55 160 55 C225 55 235 145 285 165' fill='none' stroke='#2784b5' stroke-width='5'/><line x1='35' y1='170' x2='290' y2='170' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='40' y1='170' x2='40' y2='45' stroke='#203040' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='160' cy='65' r='6' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='190' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>B = ideal</text><circle cx='250' cy='132' r='6' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='250' y='190' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>D = overstrained</text></svg>

front: What can trigger stress according to bank Q60?
back: A problem that seems to have **no solution**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Problem</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>no solution seems possible</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>stress response</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>reassess options</text></svg>

front: Which functions are affected by stress in the bank?
back: **All four:** attention, concentration, responsiveness and memory.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Stress effects</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>attention</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>concentration / response</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>memory</text></svg>

front: Do all pilots react to stress in the same way?
back: No. Reactions vary; training, experience, sleep and individual factors affect coping.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Stress</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>individual response</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>varies</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>prepare / cope</text></svg>

front: What strategies can manage stress?
back: Do: change the situation / ask help. Think: prioritize, use checklist, focus on next safe action.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Stress management</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>do / seek help</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>prioritize</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>next safe action</text></svg>

front: A passenger becomes uncomfortable during cruise. What is appropriate?
back: Adjust cabin temperature and avoid excessive banking; keep the aircraft stable.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Passenger discomfort</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>temperature</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>avoid steep bank</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>stable flight</text></svg>

front: What are the three decision/action behaviour levels?
back:
Skill-based: learned automatic action
Rule-based: apply learned procedure
Knowledge-based: analyse unfamiliar problem
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Decision levels</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>skill</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>rule</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>knowledge</text></svg>

front: What should a pilot do if a safe option remains, such as a go-around or diversion?
back: Use it. Go-around, diversion, delay or cancellation can be successful safety decisions.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Decision</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>keep options</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>go-around / divert</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>safety success</text></svg>

front: What broad factors should preflight risk assessment consider?
back: Pilot, aircraft, environment and time; evaluate likelihood and consequence.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Risk scan</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>pilot</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>aircraft / environment</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>time</text></svg>

front: What is the practical defence against visual approach illusions?
back: Use planned / published path, stabilized approach, airspeed and instrument cross-check; do not chase the illusion.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Approach defence</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>planned path</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>stable + speed</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>cross-check</text></svg>

front: Name factors that can degrade pilot performance.
back: Fatigue, illness, dehydration, stress, emotional upset and impairing medication.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Fitness</text><rect x='15' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='60' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>fatigue / illness</text><text x='111' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='115' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#27845b'/><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>dehydration / stress</text><text x='211' y='111' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' fill='#203040'>→</text><rect x='215' y='78' width='90' height='54' rx='9' fill='#d87926'/><text x='260' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='white'>medication</text></svg>

front: How does anaemia or blood loss affect oxygen transport?
back: It reduces haemoglobin / red-cell oxygen-carrying capacity.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='200' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='24' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='bold' fill='#203040'>Blood capacity</text><circle cx='75' cy='105' r='31' fill='#c83e4d'/><text x='75' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>O₂</text><text x='75' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>anaemia / blood loss</text><circle cx='160' cy='105' r='31' fill='#2784b5'/><text x='160' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>Defence</text><text x='160' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>carrying capacity ↓</text><circle cx='245' cy='105' r='31' fill='#d87926'/><text x='245' y='110' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='white'>Clot</text><text x='245' y='158' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#203040'>oxygen delivery ↓</text></svg>
